## Defiled One (CR 14)

As it releases a bone-chilling wail of agony, tears of blood cascade down the scarred, pale face of this creature.  

**XP** 38,400  
NE Medium undead  
**Init** +12; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., Lifesense 60 ft.; Perception +22  
**Aura** stench of death (30 ft., DC 24, 10 rounds)  


**Defense**


**AC** 29, touch 19, flat-footed 20 (+8 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural)  
**hp** 247 (19d8+95) + 19 (Toughness)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +12, **Will** +16  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +2, tears of acid; Immune cold, undead traits; **SR** 25  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** disfiguring touch +21 touch (14d6 negative energy plus 1d4 Charisma drain)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** disfiguring touch, scream of anguish and rage  


**Statistics**


**Str** 30, **Dex** 27, Con—, **Int** 10, **Wis** 23, **Cha** 21  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +20; **CMD** 39  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skin Suit, Spring Attack, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (touch)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (touch).*  
**Skills** Climb +25, Intimidate +21, Perception +22, Sense Motive +21, Stealth +24, Swim +22  
**Languages** Common, Necril  
**Sq** lifesense, tears of acid  


**Special Abilities**


**Disfiguring Touch (Su)** A defiled one can make a melee touch attack that disfigures its target, causing the affected skin to blister, crack, and scar.  

**Lifesense (Su)** A defiled one notices and locates living creatures within 60 feet, just as if it had the blindsight ability. It also senses the strength of life force automatically, as per deathwatch.  

**Scream Of Anguish And Rage (Su)** As a standard action, a defiled one can scream once every 1d4 rounds. All creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 24 Fortitude save. On a failed save, the target takes 12d6 sonic damage and is shaken for 1 round. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and is not shaken.  

**Stench Of Death (Ex)** When a defiled one isn’t covered by its Skin Suit, the stench of its rotten flesh is overpowering. All living creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a Fortitude saving throw or be sickened for 10 rounds (DC = 10 + 1/2 hit dice + Charisma modifier).
